name: zclass_invalidate_flag_bit8_material_images_recursive
description: zClass_Node::InvalidateFlagBit8MaterialImagesRecursive invalidates flag-bit-8 material images on a node DI and recursively on its children.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage exercises the root DI path and recursive child traversal as part of the zClass node helper smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x4528b0 validates DI pointer fetch from node->userDataOrDiRef, non-null DI invalidation, forward listB recursion, and return after listCountB entries.
The native smoke verifies recursive node material invalidation clears loaded current/cycle texture entries through the zDi and material helpers.
